title: Pod Salt Nexus Raspberry Apple Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Pod Salt Nexus Raspberry Apple Nic Salt strikes a balance between orchard and berry notes. Fresh Apple gives a clean, crisp base with a hint of natural sweetness, while Raspberry adds a tangy, jam-like sharpness that lingers on the tastebuds. The result is a bright and refreshing fruit pairing that tastes both familiar and distinctive. This Nic Salt e-liquid is blended at a 50VG/50PG ratio, making it ideal for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping with pod kits, starter devices, and vape pens. The nicotine salt formulation ensures fast nicotine delivery and a tactile yet comfortable throat hit for a smooth and consistent vape. As part of the Nexus range by Pod Salt, Raspberry Apple reflects the collection’s focus on well-defined fruit blends. Each 10ml bottle is produced in the UK to exacting standards, delivering dependable quality with every vape.
